paragraphs.text: Dragonkeeper is a 2024 animated fantasy adventure film directed by Salvador Simó and Li Jianping, with a script written by Carole Wilkinson, Pablo Castrillo, Ignacio Ferreras and Rosanna Checcini, based on Carole Wilkinson's 2003 novel Dragonkeeper. A Spanish-Chinese co-production, it opened the 27th Málaga Film Festival on 1 March 2024.
